mapper.select: SELECT city, ROUND(AVG(`value`), 1) as avgAqi FROM air_quality WHERE `type` = 'AQI' GROUP BY city ORDER BY avgAqi DESC

SELECT city, SUM(CASE WHEN `value` <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as goodHours, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN `value` <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) as goodRatio FROM air_quality WHERE `type` = 'AQI' GROUP BY city
SELECT `time`, `value` FROM air_quality WHERE `type` = 'AQI' AND city = #{city} ORDER BY `time` ASC
SELECT `type` as city, ROUND(AVG(`value`), 1) as avgAqi FROM air_quality WHERE city = #{city} GROUP BY `type`
